fallback_rate.description: Share of requests the pipeline forwarded untouched because something failed.

p95_overhead_ms.description: p95 of §3 steps 2-5 on the request path, in ms; median of 3 runs (budget 20 ms).

prefix_stability.description: Share of requests rendered after a minor compaction (plan version 2) whose bytes up to the end of version 1's frozen blocks are unchanged (D5).

render_determinism.description: Share of requests that render to identical bytes when rendered twice (ADR 0004 A2).

round_trip_identity.description: Share of requests an empty plan reproduces exactly, key order included.

token_reduction.description: 1 - estimated input tokens actually sent / tokens the client sent, over all requests.

validity_rate.description: Share of requests whose rendering on the request path passes the validator (§5).

summary.plans: standard plan per fixture session with at least 3 exchanges (docs/decisions/0010)
